integrity: The set-theoretic singular-locus study is prior work by Telen. New assertions concern minimal irreducible organization and generic Hessian/analytic types; exact coefficient checks and a self-contained proof accompany the claim. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the complex six-term cyclic hexagonal universal-adjoint quartic. Analytic normal forms and Jacobian reducedness are generic along maximal singular components; the nonreduced singular scheme and singularities at intersections are not classified. Historical priority under alternate descriptions remains a risk.
title: Morse–Bott normal forms on the singular components of a hexagonal universal adjoint
